About Drage

Our story

[Founding year and why Jon Drage started the firm, in 2–3 sentences.]

Today Drage is a team of more than 30 professionals across Coral Gables, Mexico and India. We serve individuals, families, investors and businesses whose finances cross borders.

Leadership

Jon Drage, CPA

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Jon is the founder of Drage CPA, he holds a Master of Science in Accounting with a concentration in Tax and a Bachelor of Accounting from Florida International University. Prior to founding Drage CPA, Jon was an international tax advisor at BDO USA, LLP where he worked with diverse groups of private multinational firms in all aspects of tax compliance and international information reporting.

His expertise has assisted U.S citizens, Green Card Holders and Non-Resident aliens with their tax planning, tax reporting and has successfully worked with prestigious law firms in successfully assisting clients to resolve issues with the IRS.

His knowledge and leadership guide the team at Drage CPA while fostering continued professional development and excellence.

In his free time, he enjoys traveling, cycling, and spending time at the beach with his wife, children and two rescue dogs.

Magly Rosales, MST

Partner

Magly holds a Master of Science in Taxation and a Bachelor of Accounting from Florida International University. She has over ten years of experience in international tax compliance and has worked for Big 4 accounting firms such as Price Waterhouse Coopers (PWC) and Ernst & Young (EY) where Magly prepared, reviewed, and advised on complex tax structures for high-net-worth individuals. She also has experience in Real Estate Private Equity, having served as a Fund Accounting Manager for a $40M local Florida fund.

At Drage CPA, she specializes in the taxation of individuals, international informational forms and financial statements, and provides expert compliance services and guidance to her clients.

Residing in Miami and of Venezuelan origin, she is also a Realtor and Mortgage Loan Originator. In her spare time, she enjoys playing tennis and traveling.
